items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And Butts Massico that was here just before you all came.

ctx.x: All those fishing rods reminded me of him. You're talking about flies. I know he must have

loved to fish. Les Nelson made the most beautiful. He was internationally famous for making lures, especially flies, for fly casting for bass. And he could make, he could carve a wooden lure that looked to you like it was alive. And he specialized in making ear rings with small fish. And they sold all over the world. Boy, he was an artist. Absolutely played fine tenor sax. And one of the most somber persons that you ever met in all of your life. Very seldom, if ever, laughed. That seems unusual for Dad's…
